bundle_summary: Advancing four coherent, non-IP hypotheses clustered around Mexico/Mexican-heritage identity, Gulf of Mexico geography, New Mexico state pride, and Mexico destination-occasion accessories. Quarantined FIFA World Cup 2026 and named-person political content. Digital-only SVG and non-POD seller-supply evidence excluded from validation support. Several broad product-surface terms held as ingredients.
bundle_warnings: Named-event and named-person content quarantined (World Cup 2026; Trump).
Digital-only and non-POD seller-supply evidence excluded from support (generic SVG terms; Mexico soccer SVG bundle; blown glass).
Some surfaces in supporting signals (e.g., sneakers, jerseys) may not be widely available in POD; validation queries focus on broadly available apparel/decor surfaces.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Mexican heritage/diaspora and fans expressing national pride in casual wear or sports-inspired apparel
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Demand for Mexico flag themed wearables (women’s sneakers) and combined Mexico–Puerto Rico flag motifs plus a Mexico baseball jersey query indicate interest in national-identity and sport-fan apparel.
hypotheses.label: Mexico flag pride wearables and fan-leaning styles (flag motifs and sports-adjacent)
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: National/bi-national flag identity and sport-fan styling tied to Mexico
hypotheses.uncertainty: Footwear may be outside many POD catalogs; baseball jerseys can be specialized. Validation should focus on broadly available apparel surfaces.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Couples planning Mexico destination weddings; graduates and families celebrating Guanajuato/Mexican heritage
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Specific intent for Tulum, Mexico save-the-dates and Mexico/Guanajuato graduation sashes suggests targeted occasion-based personalization tied to Mexican locations and identity.
hypotheses.label: Mexico destination and heritage celebration accessories (Tulum weddings, Guanajuato graduation)
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Location-specific occasions (Tulum weddings) and cultural/heritage graduation accessories
hypotheses.uncertainty: Some accessory types (e.g., sashes) may have limited POD fulfillment; focus validation on commonly available print surfaces for occasions.

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: People with ties to Gulf coasts (travelers, anglers, locals) seeking Gulf-themed designs
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Explicit interest in “gulf of mexico shirt” supported by broader “gulf of mexico” thematic search indicates a market for Gulf-centric designs across apparel and decor.
hypotheses.label: Gulf of Mexico themed apparel and geographic art
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: Geographic/place-based affinity for the Gulf of Mexico expressed on apparel and wall art
hypotheses.uncertainty: Broader term includes non-merch info-seeking; validation should confirm merch-intent subqueries (e.g., apparel, wall art).

hypotheses.audience_or_buyer: Residents and admirers of New Mexico’s landscapes seeking state pride art/apparel
hypotheses.concise_evidence: Interest in the phrase “new mexico strong” and in “texas and new mexico mountain art” supports a New Mexico pride and landscape-art niche.
hypotheses.label: New Mexico state pride artwork and apparel (mountain/landscape motifs)
hypotheses.theme_identity_or_occasion: State pride and mountain/landscape aesthetics tied to New Mexico
hypotheses.uncertainty: Cross-state phrasing may dilute focus; validation should compare purely New Mexico terms vs. multi-state variants.
